process() returns error when config language is unknown

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        try {
        var configJson = "{\"language\":\"nonexistent_xyz\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("x = 1", config);
        System.out.println(result);
        } catch (TreeSitterLanguagePackRsException error) {
            System.err.println(error.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + error.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```
